settings.title: Apply with a recent post
settings.text: We read the work. There is no follower minimum.

settings.title: We send a code and one piece
settings.text: The piece comes from lab-grown jewelry or our chains. Watches and estate pieces stay in the store.

settings.title: You post, your audience uses the code
settings.text: Tag @laurasgemsnyc. Say the piece was gifted, and say that you earn from the code.

settings.title: The code
settings.text: Your code is 10% off lab-grown jewelry, gold chains, and loose lab-grown diamonds. It does not apply to watches, estate jewelry, or natural diamonds. It does not combine with LMNYWELCOME or any other offer. One use per customer. The code is for your audience, not for your own order.

settings.title: What you earn
settings.text: You earn 10% of what your audience pays for those eligible pieces, after your code and before tax and shipping.

settings.title: When we pay
settings.text: We pay once a month, after the 7-day return window closes. A return comes off the balance. The balance carries until it reaches $50.

settings.title: The piece
settings.text: On acceptance, one piece from lab-grown jewelry or our chains is yours to keep. We choose it with you. Watches, estate jewelry, and loose stones are not gifted.

settings.title: The post
settings.text: In the 14 days after the piece arrives, post one feed post or Reel and two Stories. Tag @laurasgemsnyc. Say the piece was gifted. Name the metal, and say lab-grown when the diamond is lab-grown. Do not invent who owned a piece, and do not say a celebrity wears something we sell.

settings.title: How we decide
settings.text: We reply from hello@lauramilman.com. We choose from the work, not from a follower count.

settings.title: Wear it. Share it.
settings.intro: The Laura Milman influencer program is for people who already post about jewelry, watches, style, or New York. Accepted creators receive a personal code and one piece from our lab-grown jewelry or chains.
settings.success_message: Thank you. We read every application and reply from hello@lauramilman.com.
settings.privacy_note: We use this only to reply about the program.
